info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Collections API
Microsoft Windows 10 List toast notification collections

items.docs: Retrieves the list of toast notification collections for the application. Collections group related notifications using the ToastCollection and ToastCollectionManager classes.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Create a toast notification collection

items.docs: Creates a new toast notification collection for grouping related notifications. Uses the ToastCollectionManager.SaveToastCollectionAsync method.
